t: Where does the name Ilian come from?
What Does The Name Ilian Mean?
s: In the Balkans and Bulgaria, Ilian (Илиян) is commonly treated as a variant of Ilya/Ilia (Илья/Илия), ultimately from the Hebrew Eliyahu/Elijah, meaning “My God is Yahweh.” In Romance and Western contexts, Ilian can also be viewed as a modern, streamlined form influenced by names like Julian, Aurelian, or the French/Spanish/Portuguese forms of Elian/Élian, themselves connected either to Elijah or to the Latin Aelianus (from the Roman family name Aelius, possibly “of the sun”).
